mission.objective: Record sponsor decision HDI-RUNG2-006 (rung-2 attempt 3, POC Mission 023 = FAIL on duration and budget floor with mechanics clean; work quality acknowledged), the browser-tooling-availability finding with the sponsor's enablement direction, the first sizing-rule calibration verdict, and the mandatory routing to design review round 2; update the ladder status, duration-ladder plan, decision pack, and anchor registry.

verification.summary: Advisory suite run at closeout after all authorized-file edits; results recorded below. Sponsor-side independent verification of the adjudicated mission (POC full suite, 247 tests, and verify_mission_023.py, all six checks) was run before adjudication and passed.

notes: Docs-only recording mission; the verdict applies the pre-written criteria unchanged, and the round-2 routing follows the unchanged failure-handling rule, so no new judgment authority is exercised here.

The browser-tooling finding is recorded as mutable harness state with a pre-flight verification obligation, not as an excuse that converts the FAIL into a pass; the duration verdict stands on the honest numbers.
The sponsor's ~2x-scope acknowledgment is recorded as a named round-2 input, not as a decision, so the review can still weigh it against the rung-class redefinition option.
No halt or fallback trigger fired; all edits stayed inside the seven authorized files.

friction_notes: Seventh recording mission with near-identical envelope boilerplate; the parked recording-mission template candidate keeps accruing evidence.

Mission 023's friction counters extend the economics dataset to three calibrated runs: the governance ratio fell from 1.29:1 to 0.98:1 as scope grew, confirming governance cost is per-checkpoint/per-artifact rather than per-call.
false_positive_notes: None observed in this mission's advisory pass.
false_negative_notes: No false negatives observed after the advisory pass.

phase2_design_signals: The sizing rule's built-in calibration verdict turned a third failure into precise design input: one coefficient (throughput) is now proven stable across three runs while another (per-waypoint cost) is proven non-stationary, which tells the next design review exactly which variable cannot anchor a rung class.

Tool availability in the worker harness is duration-relevant mutable state: the absence of browser automation removed genuine work and shortened the run, so capability checks belong in pre-flight alongside model identity — an observation that generalizes beyond this lane.

Three attempts with improving mechanics and the same failing criterion is the clearest possible mis-specification signature; the lane's pre-written failure-handling rule converted it into mandatory design pressure instead of a fourth identical attempt.
